sermon.title: An Ear to Listen
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that the Spirit still speaks to the church, especially in our conscience, and that “hear” means listen and respond. Using an Appalachian saying and many real-life examples aimed at children, he shows that children are hurt when they don’t listen to good parents—or when parents don’t listen to God—and urges both to obey.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: “1st Corinthians 12:2” spoken for 12:8; “over a hundred thousand” alcohol-related deaths; “our president doesn’t smoke”; Prop quote on marijuana overdose. Sensitive content kept as spoken: on-screen images of drug deaths, a cancer death, a burned crash victim, syphilis and an infant with herpes; homosexuality called a lie believed from the government, activists, liberals and “the democratic party most of them,” leading to HIV/AIDS; church people “divorced at the snap of a finger”; a live snake in a box.

faqs.question: How has God spoken?
faqs.answer: By the prophets, by his Son, and by his Spirit.

faqs.question: Is the Holy Spirit a person?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Bible uses the word “he.”

faqs.question: Where does the Spirit speak to us?
Which ear is the Holy Spirit after?
faqs.answer: The inner ear, your inner spirit.

faqs.question: What is a “poke mess”?
faqs.answer: A lunch bag and a meal.

faqs.question: What does Ephesians 6:1 tell children?
faqs.answer: Obey your parents in the Lord.

faqs.question: Do you need tongues for God to speak to you?
faqs.answer: No, he speaks in your conscience.

faqs.question: What does the Bible say about evil?
What is marriage according to the message?
faqs.answer: Between a man and a woman only.
